proof_semantics.d2_order: float64(acc) * (input_scale * weight_scale)，再除 output_scale；leaky 且结果为负时再乘 binary64 0.1；half-away-from-zero；饱和到 [-127,127]。
proof_semantics.candidate_rule: 非负幅值使用精确整数 round_half_away(magnitude * M / 2**Q)，再对符号和 [-127,127] 饱和；linear 两侧共享 M/Q，leaky 两侧允许独立 M/Q。
proof_semantics.q_choice: first feasible Q in ascending order 0..65; M is nearest ideal scale rounded half away and clamped into the exact integer feasible interval
proof_semantics.linear: positive and negative domains share the same M/Q
proof_semantics.leaky: positive and negative domains may use different M/Q; negative ideal slope uses binary64 0.1 per frozen T16
proof_semantics.proof_domain: all 254 signed output transition values plus INT32_MIN and INT32_MAX endpoint outputs per channel
proof_semantics.bias: 累加器输入视为已经包含 D2 的 INT32 bias；不重复加 bias。

statistics.hardware_multiplier_width: NOT_FROZEN; mathematical M bit length is reported separately

limitations.parameter_kind: exact mathematical integer M/Q only; no RTL width, signed packing, bus encoding, or coefficient-memory layout is specified
